lines.text: The psalm asks the LORD to answer in the day of trouble and send help from the sanctuary.
It asks Him to sustain you from Sinai and remember all your gifts.
It asks Him to make all your plans succeed and hopes to raise a banner in God's name.
The LORD answers His anointed from His holy heaven with the saving power of His left hand.
Some trust chariots and horses, but we trust the LORD's name; the psalm asks Him to save the king.
